en: Black‑and‑white industrial view showing a large mining or ore‑processing facility in a barren, rocky landscape. Wooden conveyor structures and trestles run across the scene, with piles of processed material in the foreground and several wooden buildings scattered along a hillside in the background. The printed caption "Foldals Verk" appears in the upper left, and a reference code "MINØ.25991" is printed in the lower right.
